name: Extreme Power Championship
epitaph: Extreme Power's own top championship, billed as held by Batista as of the promotion's own 8 December 2006 show. The same document also calls the title the "World Heavyweight Championship" in its own next-week teaser line, without explaining the two names -- both are treated here as the same title as the source itself does. Batista was due to defend it against Undertaker the following week; that show was not captured.

name: Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Billed as held by Jeff Hardy from the promotion's own 8 December 2006 show onward. A title defence against Carlito and AJ Styles was announced for the following week, but the next captured show swapped in CM Punk as a non-title opponent instead; no title defence survives in the documents held here.

name: Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by D-Generation X (Shawn Michaels & Triple H) from Edge and Randy Orton on 8 December 2006, and defended successfully the following night against Chris Jericho and Bubba Ray Dudley.
